title: fremontia californica subsp. crassifolia
intro: Fremontia californica subsp. crassifolia, commonly known as California fleabane or Fremont's fleabane, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fremontia californica subsp. crassifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
